description: Production setup since 1.0.0 (the Radiance launch of docker-vllm7.service on LXC 2408, unit disabled; the production LLM itself is radiance-serve on LXC 2413): Swift-1.5 checkpoint /root/swift-heretic-gptq (served name slybase/Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-27B-MXFP4-GPTQ) + DFlash2 k=7, R4D_HYBRID, util 0.98, FULL_DECODE_ONLY, RADIANCE_MXFP4_WIDE_MAX_M=192, RADIANCE_ADAPTIVE_WIDTH=perseq (README reference launch). The gate does NOT carry a copy of that launch: gpu-window reads the ExecStart of the live docker-vllm7.service and only swaps image, container name and compile-cache directories, so the homelab unit is the one place that defines the launch; this profile only declares what to assert.
required_log_patterns: all linear layers on our kernel
\[radiance\.mxfp4\] linear layers: (\d+)/\1 on our kernel, 0 FORCED
drafter attention takes the drafter's call
forbidden_log_patterns: Capturing CUDA graphs? failed|CUDAGraph capture failed
lookup draft: (off after an error|not hooked)
known_warnings: Cubin file saved by TritonBundler not found
Failed to JIT torch c dlpack extension

smoke.name: arithmetic
smoke.prompt: What is 17*23? Reply with the number only.

smoke.name: reasoning parser
smoke.prompt: A train leaves at 14:35 and arrives 2h47m later. What time does it arrive? Answer with HH:MM only.

smoke.name: tool call
smoke.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin? Use the tool.

smoke_note: Every answer is additionally checked for leaked <think>/</think> tags (reasoning parser armed); an empty reasoning_content is normal for easy prompts.
